I drafted and sent four disputes, worth $79.15 in total. The owner approved each send. Every case has a 10-day window, so the next deadline is **2026-11-24**.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| DD-51152 | $28.40 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Chicken Thukpa. The order was ready at 20:26 and picked up at 20:29. |
| DD-51123 | $14.25 | 90% (moderate) | The ticket lists Veg Momo (Fried). The order was ready at 18:36 and picked up at 18:40. |
| DD-51115 | $17.50 | 80% (moderate) | The ticket lists Jhol Momo. The order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58. |
| DD-51131 | $19.00 | 77% (moderate) | The ticket lists Chicken Momo (Steamed). The order was ready at 19:31 and picked up at 19:34. |

- **Packing:** No evidence shows what was in the bag. The tickets show what was prepared, not what was packed.
- **Past results:** Similar past disputes won 2 of 3. The one loss involved a side item that wasn't itemised on the ticket.
- **DD-51152:** It has no past case with the same evidence pattern. Its ticket omits the item, so the past results are only a rough guide.
- **DD-51131:** It is a wrong-item claim, and there is no history for that type.
- **DD-51123:** Its 90% is higher than the evidence alone supports. The same account made 3 claims this period. I left the claim count out of the disputes so they state facts only.

**Weak, needs your input**
- **DD-51102 ($46.80):** There is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't compare the claimed Chicken Momo Party Tray to the order. Its win probability fell from 60% to 35%. **Please send a photo of the ticket for this order.** It is the largest deduction, so the photo is worth finding.

**Not investigated yet**
- **DD-51140 ($13.75) and DD-51160 ($9.50):** Both are at 60% and I only worked the top 5 cases. I can check them next if you want.

**Skipped**
- **DD-51171 ($11.00):** It has a 15% win probability.
- **DD-50980 ($0.00):** It is a $0 deduction and its deadline passed 11 days ago.

I saved the case notes to `/plan.md`.
